coverage.main: Read all nine pages of arXiv 1812.03413v3 (25 November 2019, AAAI 2020 copyright): method, experimental setup, Tables 1-4, Figures 1-6 and references.
coverage.supplement: The paper says additional experimental results are provided in its repository. The four-page 'Supplementary material' (experiments_result.pdf, pinned commit) was read: per-source Figures 1-6 and Table 1 with per-target multi-model attack rates.
coverage.excluded_results: White-box columns of main Table 4 and the white-box Res-50 column of supplement Table 1 are excluded. Figures 4-5 describe ghost-network accuracy and diversity. Main Table 2 averages over all nine models, including the white-box Res-50 source, so its averages are superseded by the per-target black-box columns of supplement Table 1 (for example, M1 I-FGSM: mean of the nine supplement values = 25.5, as printed).

result_groups.locator: Single-model Attack; Table 1 (p. 5); Figure 6; supplement Figures 1-6
result_groups.population: 5,000 ILSVRC 2012 validation images correctly classified by all nine base models; one of six normally trained sources; tested on the other eight (six normal, three ensemble-adversarially trained)
result_groups.outcome: attack rate (black-box average in Table 1; per target in figures)
result_groups.evidence: 'we select 5000 images from the ILSVRC 2012 validation set, which can be correctly classified by all the 9 base models' (p. 5). No source-success rule is stated.

result_groups.locator: Multi-model Attack, Same Architecture; Table 2 (p. 5); supplement Table 1
result_groups.population: Same 5,000 images; sources Res-50-A/B/C and their ghost networks; tested on the nine base models
result_groups.outcome: attack rate per target (supplement) and nine-model average including the white-box source (Table 2)
result_groups.evidence: Same clean-correct population for the nine evaluated models. Res-50-B and -C are sources only.

result_groups.population: Same 5,000 images; ensemble of five of six normal models tested on the held-out one, and all six tested on three adversarially trained models
result_groups.evidence: Same clean-correct population; no source-success rule.

result_groups.locator: NeurIPS 2017 Adversarial Challenge; Table 4 black-box columns (p. 7)
result_groups.population: 'The test dataset contains 5000 images' with ImageNet labels; eight-model ensemble source with per-image epsilon drawn from {4, 8, 12, 16}; TsAIL, iyswim and Anil Thomas defenses
result_groups.evidence: The text does not say whether this is the same clean-correct 5,000-image set, and the defenses were not part of the correctness filter.

f1.evidence: Base-model top-1 accuracy on the full validation set appears only graphically (erosion magnitude 0 in Figure 4); no numerical clean accuracy is printed.

f2.evidence: Three scopes explicitly use images all nine models classify correctly (yes); the challenge-defense scope is unresolved. Positive conditioning evidence.

f3.evidence: No source-success rule or explicit inclusion statement in any scope.

f4.evidence: All 36 Table 3 cells map to unique counts over 5,000 (survey/count_reconstruction.py; for example, 71.08% = 3,554). The supplement's per-target cells likewise have the 0.02% resolution of a 5,000 denominator. Main Tables 1 and 2 are averages, and Table 4's denominator is unstated.

f5.locator: Ghost Networks (||r||_inf < epsilon); Parameter Specification (p. 5); NeurIPS challenge paragraph
f5.evidence: L-infinity epsilon = 8 for Tables 1-3; the challenge scope draws epsilon per image from {4, 8, 12, 16}.

f6.evidence: The official repository releases attack and evaluation code, the 5,000-image list, ground truth, and links to preprocessed images and renamed checkpoints. It could support recomputation of the model-to-model scopes; links, checkpoint contents and execution were not verified. Challenge defenses are external.

artifact_checks.result: Linked in the paper. Listed via the GitHub API (34 files, head 25 February 2019): attack.py, eval.py, config.py, networks/, data/list/test_list5000.txt (5,000 entries), data/valid_gt.csv, experiments_result.pdf; README links SharePoint downloads of preprocessed images and checkpoints. eval.py prints 1 - accuracy over the listed images for each test network, so source failures are retained; artifact evidence only. Not executed; download links not tested.

bounds_checks.reason: Rates are over images all nine models classify correctly, so the reported rate is already conditional on clean correctness; no unconditional baseline on a matched population is reported.
No clean accuracy of the defense submissions on the test images is reported.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. The repository PDF is treated as the paper's supplement because the paper directs readers to it for additional results.
